# MineTrans Insurance Brokers

> Specialist mining and marine insurance brokerage serving South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa. MineTrans structures insurance for mine assets, liability, business interruption, plant and machinery, and land, air and sea transit of valuable metals. A division of Donaldson Advisory Group, an authorised financial services provider, FSP No. 53166.

Canonical website: https://www.minetrans.co.za/

## Entity information
MineTrans Insurance Brokers is a specialist insurance brokerage focused on mining and marine risk. It is a division of Donaldson Advisory Group and operates in South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa. Financial Services Provider number: FSP 53166.

Areas of expertise: mining insurance, business interruption insurance and indemnity periods, declared values and the average clause, critical-asset risk surveys, single-point-of-failure mapping, machinery breakdown and yellow metal cover, tailings storage facility risk and GISTM alignment, SASRIA strike/riot/civil commotion extensions, power and water interruption exposure, marine and inland transit of concentrate and precious metals, and claims advocacy.

MineTrans acts for the client, not for the insurer: it quantifies risk, structures the insurance programme, presents it to underwriters with evidence, and advocates at claim stage.
